title: IMMEDIATE DISCLOSURE REQUEST (Department of Emergency Management)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

IMMEDIATE DISCLOSURE REQUEST

Under the San Francisco Sunshine Ordinance and the California Public Records Act, I request copies of all video recordings from any City-owned or City-operated camera with a view of the intersection of McAllister Street and Leavenworth Street, San Francisco, on Friday, September 19, 2026, between 7:30 PM and 8:00 PM.

This specifically includes: (1) the camera mounted on the pedestrian signal pole at the intersection; (2) the two exterior cameras on 100 McAllister Street facing McAllister and/or Leavenworth Street; and (3) the two exterior cameras on the Federal Office Building at 50 United Nations Plaza facing McAllister and/or Leavenworth Street. It also includes any other SFMTA traffic or signal cameras, onboard cameras on any Muni vehicle passing through the intersection during that window, and any public or community safety cameras. If SFMTA does not hold these records, please route this request to the department or agency that does.

The footage relates to a two-vehicle collision at approximately 7:45 PM between a white Lexus (inside lane) and a second vehicle, both making a right turn from McAllister Street onto Leavenworth Street.

Please preserve all responsive footage immediately while this request is processed, as I understand it may be subject to automatic deletion. I prefer electronic delivery.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Krysta Yeates
